privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.lead: This policy describes how VolleyTrack handles personal data on the sports management platform for volleyball coaches and teams.
privacy_policy.s1_p1: VolleyTrack is a software-as-a-service (SaaS) platform for organizing training, rosters, and sports performance. The data processing described here is carried out for the benefit of platform users and individuals whose data they register, such as athletes and team members.
privacy_policy.s2_intro: We may process the following categories of data:
privacy_policy.s2_li1_text: Name, email, access credentials, account information, subscription, and usage preferences.
privacy_policy.s2_li2_text: Information entered by users about athletes and teams (for example: name, position, training attendance, statistics, and sports records).
privacy_policy.s2_li3_text: IP address, browser type, device, date and time of access, and logs required for security and system operation.
privacy_policy.s2_li4_text: Platform usage records, error logs, and information needed to keep the service stable and secure.
privacy_policy.s3_li1: Operate and improve the VolleyTrack platform;
privacy_policy.s3_li2: Enable sports management of teams, training sessions, and players;
privacy_policy.s3_li3: Authenticate users and protect accounts from unauthorized access;
privacy_policy.s3_li4: Provide support and communicate relevant information about the service;
privacy_policy.s3_li5: Comply with legal obligations and resolve security incidents.
privacy_policy.s4_intro: Personal data processing at VolleyTrack follows the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), in particular:
privacy_policy.s4_li1_text: When processing is necessary to provide the service you requested or subscribed to.
privacy_policy.s4_li2_text: When we need to ensure security, prevent fraud, maintain system stability, or improve features, always balanced against your rights.
privacy_policy.s4_p2: When another legal basis applies in specific situations, you will be informed clearly.
privacy_policy.s5_p1: Data may be stored on cloud computing services, including Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure. We adopt reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect information, such as access controls and protected communication where applicable.
privacy_policy.s5_p2: No system on the internet is completely invulnerable. We encourage strong passwords and safeguarding your account credentials.
privacy_policy.s6_intro_after: your personal data. Sharing occurs only when necessary for:
privacy_policy.s6_li1: Technical operation of the platform (for example, hosting and cloud infrastructure providers);
privacy_policy.s6_li2: Compliance with legal obligations, court orders, or requests from competent authorities.
privacy_policy.s7_p1: We retain data for as long as necessary to operate the platform, meet legal obligations, and resolve disputes. When no longer needed, we seek to delete or anonymize it securely.
privacy_policy.s7_p2: You may request deletion of data, subject to legal and contractual limitations that require retention for a defined period.
privacy_policy.s8_intro: Under the GDPR, you may request, among other things:
privacy_policy.s8_li1: Confirmation of and access to processed data;
privacy_policy.s8_li2: Correction of incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data;
privacy_policy.s8_li3: Erasure of unnecessary or unlawfully processed data;
privacy_policy.s8_li4: Information about sharing and processing carried out.
privacy_policy.s8_p2: To exercise your rights, contact us using the email below. We will respond within a reasonable time.
privacy_policy.s9_p1: Questions about privacy or requests related to personal data:
privacy_policy.s10_p1: We may update this policy to reflect changes to the service or applicable law. We recommend reviewing this page periodically.
